newsitem.title: COTE D'IVOIRE: Ivory Coast lifts more price controls.
newsitem.headline: Ivory Coast lifts more price controls.

text.p: The Ivory Coast government has lifted price controls on more goods and services as part of its continuing effort to liberalise the economy, according to an official statement published on Friday.

The measure frees the price of locally produced cigarettes and cigars, sugar, jute and sisal sacks, medical services, school fees, taxi fares plus the services undertaken by the body that checks safety standards in buildings, SECUREL.

The government said that the only remaining price controls in Ivory Coast covered bread, butane gas, locally-published primary school books, certain pharmaceuticals, indicative prices for coffee, cocoa, cotton and rubber, plus water, electricity, mail and telecommunications.
